desc: Evergreen documentation hygiene. Full 2026-07-24 reconciliation now includes B0 ticket-100 PASS, conditional dual-mode review 119, HPM2 0x07->0x00 plus final R3 rollback no-go, recovery-control PASS, IRQ-816 console PASS, PCIe op115 negative, maxcpus2 negative plus reviewed replacement 123, trackpad-004 static NO-GO plus byte-reproduced/reviewed offline 125 and unapproved live 126, corrected ALS preflight PASS, and OpenRC image 098. Continue converting every result and dead end into a documented grave. LESSON 2026-07-25 (claude): any B0 userland assertion observable ONLY on the internal panel must also be mirrored into the ttydc0 health report, or an agent cannot verify it without the maintainer. This is why a broken Norwegian keymap shipped unnoticed (OpenRC ebegin goes to the console, not ttydc0); fixed by adding a '-- console keymap --' line to scripts/t6040-b0-health-report reading /run/wallace-keymap-status. Apply the same rule to future panel-only checks. Also: prefer positive readings over inferences from silence — several wrong conclusions on 2026-07-25 came from treating absent console output as evidence.
